ratings_why.fun: A Recipe that grows all game and a lamp-plus-Drawn placement puzzle give a satisfying climb, though turns 2 to 5 rest on tiny Phials.
ratings_why.distinct: A tribe that makes spells and pours them on any tribe's carry, with Alchymist stealing keywords, plays unlike today's six; spell-scaling tribes exist elsewhere, so not higher.

verdict_why: The tier jobs and growth shape are right, but a few cards don't say how they count or resolve, and those need a pass.

points.text: The Alchymist adds a line every Start of Turn, and once the Recipe is full that forces a replacement. Say whether the line is optional, and what happens when every board keyword is already on the Recipe.

With Dame Pavonia, does one Phial count as one or two casts for Honeysuckle Nurse, Mortar Grinder and Old Carbonaria? The text says each cast counts as a spell, but the Nurse triggers on casting a Phial.
Say whether The Herald's fight cast (and Psyche's) counts toward Old Carbonaria's game-long spell count; if it does, Carbonaria grows every fight without any shop play.
Turns 2 to 5 are thin: a +1/+1 Phial on a 2/3 is one stat. A Tier 1 or 2 unit that casts the Recipe at Start of Combat would give the early climb a body to win with.
Primrose Apprentice is the card every Moth player buys first and triples. That's fine for a key card, but a second T2 line-adder with a different line would make early drafts less of a single hunt.

standouts.why: Burnt Ring Warden makes slot placement the engine and is a clean T4 multiplier: three recipients, then Drawn neighbours.
The Alchymist turns the lobby's other tribes into Recipe lines, a capstone you build differently every game.
The Herald gives the late game a big Start of Combat moment, and its slot order with Burnet lines is a real placement choice.

weakest.why: Wing-Dust Peddler is a 1/2 with a one-stat Phial on turn 1; it loses early fights and seeds little.
The Uncertain pays you to hold a Phial in a 4-card hand, which fights the tribe's own supply.
Mother Shipton does nothing with a keyword Recipe, so she is a dead draw for the Dispensary build.

flags.note: Five +1/+1 lines make a Phial worth +50% of the target; Pavonia's double cast makes it about x2.25, and three Phials a turn make one lamp about x10 a turn. Nightshade and Mother Shipton are the counterplay; worth a sim.
Old Carbonaria as the lamp stacks a growing flat bonus, Drawn and percentage Phials on one unit.
A forced line replacement every turn once the Recipe is full is not ruled.
Atropos and Treacle Painter depend on an unsettled shop spell price; at a 0-1 price the Night Market loops gold into Phials fast.
